description: In repos/activity-api/src/routes/goal-paths.ts, inside the normalizeGoal function, add exactly one new .replace call immediately after the .trim() call. The new call must be .replace(/^\[[^\]]*\]\s*/, '') so that a leading bracketed correlation token is removed before the existing hex-elision replace runs. Do not add any import. Do not modify any other line or any other function. The change must typecheck.
